headline: TabPFN and TabICL win against tuned XGBoost on 14 tables without training
summary: These AI models predict on tabular data without explicit training, outperforming tuned XGBoost across fourteen different datasets in recent measurements.
details: TabPFN and TabICL, two innovative AI models, have demonstrated a remarkable ability to predict on tabular data without requiring any explicit training. This claim was put to the test against a highly tuned XGBoost model.

The results showed TabPFN and TabICL emerging victorious on all fourteen tables measured. This performance highlights a significant advancement in machine learning, challenging traditional methods that rely heavily on extensive training phases.

The core idea behind these models is to leverage in-context learning, allowing them to generalize from a few examples without a dedicated training loop. This approach could drastically reduce the time and computational resources needed for data analysis.

Further measurements and detailed analysis of this comparison are available, providing insights into the methodology and the implications of such 'no-training' models for the future of tabular data prediction.

headline_marked: [[Generate 30-minute AI podcasts]] from script in under a minute with ElevenLabs
headline: Generate 30-minute AI podcasts from script in under a minute with ElevenLabs
summary: ElevenLabs' cutting-edge voice AI platform allows developers to transform raw text into professional-sounding MP3 episodes, complete with voice cloning and audio merging.
details: Podcasts are popular but time-consuming to produce. This guide demonstrates building an AI Podcast Generator using ElevenLabs to convert raw text scripts into polished MP3 episodes, capable of generating a 30-minute episode in under a minute.

ElevenLabs is a leading voice AI platform known for its realistic voice cloning and user-friendly REST API. It offers natural-sounding voices that rival human narrators, with flexible per-character pricing and a free tier for testing.

The generator handles longer scripts by splitting them into logical sections and processing each chunk via the API. It also integrates ffmpeg to merge audio tracks, allowing for the addition of intro music, background ambience, or ad slots.

While runnable locally, the guide suggests deploying the solution as a serverless function or a Flask API on platforms like Render or AWS Lambda. This enables a fully automated, production-grade podcast generation pipeline accessible via HTTP requests.

The core power comes from ElevenLabs' advanced AI, ensuring the final audio sounds like a professional narrator rather than a robotic readout. Developers can experiment with voice settings to fine-tune the output.
